summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a docstring and a nested add_to_cbd helper covering the three CBD rules, including untyped reification. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering the rule 1/2 counts (8, 3, 2, 0), typed and untyped reifiers (8, 13), incoming-reification exclusion, blank-node non-expansion via reification, a blank-node cycle, and source immutability. Nothing was run; the expected counts were derived by hand. Nothing was committed. Next step: run the new test file and flake8 to confirm.
